import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, k, mod;
    static int[] factorials = new int[262155];
    static int[] invFactorials = new int[262155];
    static int[] logs = new int[262155];
    static int[] cnt2 = new int[262155];
    static int[][] dp = new int[262155][31];
    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[262155][31];
    static List<int[]> trace = new ArrayList<>();
    static Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();

    static int readInteger(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        int x = 0;
        boolean negative = false;
        int c;
        while (true) {
            c = br.read();
            if (c == -1) break;
            if (c == '-') {
                negative = true;
                break;
            }
            if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                x = c - '0';
                break;
            }
        }
        while (true) {
            c = br.read();
            if (c == -1 || !Character.isDigit(c)) break;
            x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
        }
        return negative ? -x : x;
    }

    static int countDiv2(int x) {
        int count = 0;
        while (x != 0 && (x & 1) == 0) {
            count++;
            x >>= 1;
        }
        return count;
    }

    static int fastPower(int base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        long b = base;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * b) % mod;
            }
            b = (b * b) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) res;
    }

    static int choose(int n, int m) {
        return (int) (((long) factorials[n] * invFactorials[m] % mod) * invFactorials[n - m] % mod);
    }

    static int recurse(int n, int k) {
        if (n == 0) return 1;
        if (k == 0) return 0;
        if (dp[n][k] != -1) return dp[n][k];
        int res = 0;
        int limit = 1 << logs[n];
        for (int i = n; i >= limit; i -= 2) {
            res = (res + (long) choose(n, i) * recurse(n - i, k - 1) % mod * k) % mod;
        }
        return dp[n][k] = res;
    }

    static int runBFS(int n, int k) {
        q.clear();
        q.add(new int[]{n, k});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] front = q.poll();
            int x = front[0], y = front[1];
            trace.add(new int[]{x, y});
            if (x == 0 || y == 0) continue;
            int limit = 1 << logs[x];
            for (int i = x; i >= limit; i -= 2) {
                if (cnt2[i] + cnt2[x - i] == cnt2[x] && !visited[i][y - 1]) {
                    visited[i][y - 1] = true;
                    q.add(new int[]{i, y - 1});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = trace.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int[] pair = trace.get(i);
            int x = pair[0], y = pair[1];
            if (x == 0) {
                dp[x][y] = 1;
                continue;
            }
            if (y == 0) {
                dp[x][y] = 0;
                continue;
            }
            int limit = 1 << logs[x];
            for (int i = x; i >= limit; i -= 2) {
                if (cnt2[i] + cnt2[x - i] == cnt2[x]) {
                    dp[x][y] = (int) ((dp[x][y] + (long) choose(x, i) * dp[x - i][y - 1] % mod * y) % mod);
                }
            }
        }
        return dp[n][k];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = readInteger(br);
        k = readInteger(br);
        mod = readInteger(br);

        for (int i = 0; i < 262155; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dp[i], -1);
        }
        for (boolean[] row : visited) {
            Arrays.fill(row, false);
        }

        factorials[0] = 1;
        logs[0] = -1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 262150; i++) {
            factorials[i] = (int) ((long) factorials[i - 1] * i % mod);
            logs[i] = logs[i >> 1] + 1;
            cnt2[i] = cnt2[i - 1] + countDiv2(i);
        }

        invFactorials[262150] = fastPower(factorials[262150], mod - 2);
        for (int i = 262149; i > 0; i--) {
            invFactorials[i] = (int) ((long) invFactorials[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod);
        }
        invFactorials[0] = invFactorials[1];

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(fastPower(k, n));
        } else {
            int cnt = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 62; i++) {
                if (((long) n & (1L << i)) != 0) cnt++;
            }
            int ans = fastPower(k, n);
            int bfsResult = runBFS(n, k);
            int result = ((ans - bfsResult) % mod + mod) % mod;
            System.out.println(result);
        }
    }
}
